posts.title: Duck: A Customized LSP for Berger-Levrault. Because, why not ?
posts.excerpt: The Language Server Protocol (LSP) is a standard that defines how code editors communicate with language-specific servers to provide advanced development features such as autocompletion, go-to-definition, find references, and diagnostics (errors and warnings).
